name: Louie R. Guenthner, Jr.
summary: Louis Robert Guenthner Jr. (August 9, 1944 – August 7, 2012), was an attorney from Louisville, Kentucky, who was a Republican former member of the Kentucky House of Representatives, having represented the 48th District in Jefferson County from 1974 to 1989. The district included the affluent areas of Indian Hills and Prospect.
